name: [Equip] Daily Challenge worker is erroring
message:
The nightly Daily Challenge worker ended in `error` or `no_actor` on two of the last three nights.

* `no_actor` — there is no active admin to attribute generated questions to (`replenish.py`). Somebody's admin role was removed or the account deactivated.
* `error` — generation, publish or scheduling threw. The tick's WARNING line names the stage (`generation:`, `publish:`, `schedule:`, `stuck at status=`).

`no_survivors` (every candidate rejected by a gate) has its own monitor, «Daily Challenge generator produced nothing».

Logs: `service:equip-backend status:warn "replenish:"`
